system.description: At any point during a turn, even after you have been "killed," you may declare the use of Aegis. Expend either a permanent Willpower Trait or three permanent Physical Traits. Any damage you have taken in that turn is removed, and you take no damage for the rest of the turn. This power must be used before a new turn begins — you cannot use it to undo previous damage. The Traits spent do not return at the end of the session, but can be repurchased with Experience Traits.
system.bloodCost: 1 permanent Willpower Trait or 3 permanent Physical Traits
